source_caption:
🎥🎬: Sit Down, Shut Up (2009)

At Knob Haven High School, a group of wildly eccentric teachers tries to survive their daily lives while dealing with their students, personal drama, and each other. Instead of being role models, they constantly create ridiculous problems of their own.

From awkward relationships to bizarre school situations, the staff’s attempts to maintain order usually end in complete chaos. The series turns ordinary high-school life into an absurd workplace comedy.

source_details.synopsis: Sit Down, Shut Up (sometimes also known as Sit Down, Shut Up! in some promos) is an American adult animated television series developed by Mitchell Hurwitz for the Fox Broadcasting Company. The series focuses on a group of high school teachers in a small town in Florida "who don't care about teaching". The series premiered on April 19, 2009, in the Fox's Animation Domination block on Fox, but after four episodes aired, Fox removed the show from the block due to low ratings. The remaining nine episodes aired on Saturdays at midnight from later in the year. The show was cancelled on November 21, 2009.
